citationText: 5. The software for focus is trivial. The problem is hardware devices fast enough to do useful intra-image focus. Pangolin has developed a preliminary specification for such devices, in the hopes of avoiding a multiplicity of incompatible techniques. The specs are available upon request from Pangolin.
